text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — ran the fortnightly privilege-rot scan, seeing ~118 admin roles with zero activity for 90+ days. Also noticed KMS key bindings changed in a few accounts but audit-log entries don't have role_owner correlation. Anyone seen this mismatch? @audit-bot did we drop any link fields?
Jonathan Park: Noted. Can you paste the scan output? is this across prod and staging?
Maria Chen: Prod only. snippet:
```
role_id: admin-team-42 last_active: 2025-11-02 owner: unassigned
kms_key: projects/prod/keyrings/rdrw-icing binding_updated: 2026-01-15
audit_log_id: c3f9... (no role_name)
```
Kevin Liu: @maria what query did you use? our new audit pipeline should join kms.audit_entries -> iam.role_changes by principal_email. sometimes service account renames break the join.
Maria Chen: Query: `SELECT r.role_id, r.last_active, k.binding_updated, a.log_id FROM roles r LEFT JOIN kms_bindings k ON r.principal = k.principal LEFT JOIN audit_entries a ON a.target_resource = k.resource` — returns a bunch of nulls in a.log_id.
Sophie Ramos: Re: SA renames — we started annotating SA tokens with `x-rd-service-id` in 2025-12 to preserve mapping. Are those annotations present in your audit_entries?
Maria Chen: I don't see x-rd-service-id for those entries. audit-bot shows old ingestion version for that project.
audit-bot: ingest-status prod-project-7: version=1.8.2 -> schema=v1 (missing annotations). Re-run recommended: `/audit reingest prod-project-7 --schema v2`
Jonathan Park: If reingest fixes it we should backfill mapping. Two tasks: 1) reingest project, 2) build fallback heuristic: match by key fingerprint + time window.
Kevin Liu: For fallback, we use:
```
-- pseudo-SQL
SELECT a.log_id, k.key_fingerprint, r.role_id
FROM audit_entries a JOIN kms_bindings k ON a.key_fprint = k.key_fingerprint
WHERE ABS(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(a.ts, k.updated_ts, SECOND)) < 300
```
That recovers ~70% historically.
Sophie Ramos: Let's schedule a brief runbook: reingest, run heuristic, create owner tickets for unresolved roles, and temporary auto-stepdown for roles with >120 days no owner.
Maria Chen: +1. Can we also auto-create a ticket to tag owner=?unknown and set expiry 7 days? I can script that.
Jonathan Park: pls add me on the ticket. Also propose we add a periodic monitor that alerts when mismatch_count > 10: `alert:priv-rot-mismatch`.
Kevin Liu: I'll open infra PR to add the alert and the reingest CLI helper.
Sophie Ramos: I'll draft the runbook steps and incident play for if reingest fails (we'll fallback to manual audit + cross-team outreach).
Maria Chen: Thanks all. I'll kick off `/audit reingest prod-project-7` in 5. ping here with status.
Maria Chen: (later) reingest started, seeing progress logs:
```
[2026-03-22T14:02:01Z] ingest: file=000134.json processed=1200/4321
[2026-03-22T14:03:33Z] schema check passed v2
[2026-03-22T14:04:00Z] annotations restored for 83 entries
```
Jonathan Park: Nice. Keep us posted. :thumbsup:
Sophie Ramos: If we see <80% recovery we'll run full manual owner outreach.
Maria Chen: Current recovery after reingest + heuristic: 92 roles auto-mapped, 26 open tickets created. Ticket batch link: https://rwd.inc/tickets/PRIV-2026-309
Kevin Liu: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/547 — adds alert + reingest helper
audit-bot: alert created: priv-rot-mismatch prod-project-7 threshold=10
Maria Chen: closing loop — plan: run full sweep next week, set auto-stepdown for unclaimed after 14 days. Thanks everyone.
